description: Creates a private plumbing/heating enquiry to L&G through contact Patrick Kaufmann at office@installateur1210.at for all 23 Vienna districts, and queues a business email. Requires explicit customer authorisation for the exact details, named recipient and current privacy version. Free enquiry; no booking, emergency dispatch, payment, publication or resale. Production accepts real customer enquiries only. The idempotency key is a new random 16–100 character value; identical retries return the same receipt, while changed input under that key is rejected. Returns only a receipt, never customer data or credentials.
